title: Size of a circuit layer
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit from $	ext{Fin}\,n$ to a singleton, using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates. For each natural number $j$, define its successor-layer size to be the number of nodes in layer $j+1$ when $j$ is less than the circuit depth, and zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: F is a layered circuit from Fin n to a singleton over Boolean values
Every layer's node type is finite
F uses only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates
